description: This file defines the MapContext class, which provides a composite view over a collection of Maps organized in a deque, supporting layered map operations such as push and pop, along with map-like access methods.

classes.name: MapContext
classes.description: A class implementing Map that provides a view over a deque of maps, allowing layered and prioritized key-value lookups and modifications.

methods.name: getContexts
methods.description: Returns the internal deque of maps representing different layers.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a new empty map to the top of the context stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds an existing map to the top of the context stack.

methods.name: addToBottom
methods.description: Adds an existing map to the bottom of the context stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the top map from the stack, preserving at least one map.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Calculates the total number of unique keys across all maps.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether all maps in the context are empty.

methods.name: entryStream
methods.description: Creates a stream of unique entries from all maps, avoiding duplicate keys.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if any map contains the specified key.

methods.name: containsValue
methods.description: Checks if any map contains the specified value.

methods.name: withContextContainingKey
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve a value for a key from the first map in the context that contains it.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the specified key, considering the layered maps.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a localized value for a key considering locale, if the map supports localization.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Puts a key-value pair into the top map in the context stack.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the top map in the context stack.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Adds all entries from a provided map into the top map.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entries in the top map.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns a set of all unique keys across all maps.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns a collection of all values across all maps.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns a set of all entries across all maps, ensuring no duplicate keys.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the layered maps for debugging.
